reason: I'd sign up for the free plan in five minutes because I try everything, but I already have a chatbot and I keep maybe one tool in ten. I wouldn't pay anything in the first month until I've seen it do something my current chat can't.
objection: I already have a chatbot, why add or switch? An agent that clicks, adds to cart and fills forms on my site sounds like a liability until I see it work on my own pages without breaking anything.
would_change_my_mind: A free-plan trial on my real site where the A/B report shows a clear lift in sign-ups within a couple of weeks, with the confirm-before-submit step working cleanly.
